blocks.text: Khule hue strands par naya DNA tab tak nahin ban sakta jab tak template par pehle se kuch nucleotides na lage hon. Is ke liye enzyme primase origin site par har template strand ke saamne kuch RNA nucleotides laga deta hai. 5-10 RNA nucleotides ke is chhote tukre ko primer kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Replication bubble: double helix beech se khulta hai aur dono siron par replication fork hai. Har fork par aage duplex par gyrase aur fork par helicase; peele single-strand binding proteins alag strands ko thaame rakhte hain; jamni primase har fork ke qareeb template strand par chhota primer rakhta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.10: Replication: strands ka khulna aur primer ka jurna (kitab ki Figure 19.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
